contents: THREE supplementary FIGURES only; no additional Methods text.

S1.caption_excerpt: Prediction accuracy of the vis2vis and vis2img models for subjects 2-8 of NSD Imagery dataset ... voxelwise prediction accuracies ... 2D colorbar where 'blue' regions indicate higher vis2vis accuracy, 'orange' indicate higher 'vis2img' accuracy
S1.bearing: Per-subject cortical prediction maps (subj02-08); supports the broad-cortical, across-subject prediction claim P-C1.

S2.caption_excerpt: Average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for subjects 1-8 ... Top row ... two vision runs ... Middle/Bottom ... imagery runs
S2.bearing: Vision SNR high & concentrated in early visual cortex (up to ~0.5); imagery SNR markedly lower and diffuse. Context (possible explanation for noisy imagery reduced-rank curves); NOT a method spec.

S3.caption_excerpt: The imagery subspace may exhibit lower dimensionality than the visual subspace through different configurations ... All data in this figure are simulated.
S3.bearing: Explicitly SIMULATED conceptual illustration of the alignment/dimensionality framework; reaffirms the paper's imagery-lower-dimensional framing (so our dimensionality discordance is a genuine disagreement, not a misreading). No data, no new method.

verdict: Supplement 1 introduces NO method detail that contradicts the S2.5M/S2.6R implementation; it is figures-only and consistent with the reconstruction. S2_7R_NEW_MATERIAL_METHOD_GAP NOT raised.
feature_correspondence_note: Fig 5C-E (feature/tuning correspondence, F-C1) is in the MAIN text, not the supplement; NOT reconstructed in Track R.
